question: Find the first and last name of artists who have painting but no sculpture work.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "artists" AS SELECT "artistid" AS "artistid", "fname" AS "fname", "lname_part1" AS "lname_part1", "lname_part2" AS "lname_part2" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paintings" AS SELECT "painterid" AS "painterid" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "sculptures" AS SELECT "sculptorid" AS "sculptorid" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH painters AS (
    SELECT painterid AS artistid, COUNT(*) AS painting_cnt
    FROM paintings
    GROUP BY painterid
), sculptors AS (
    SELECT sculptorid AS artistid, COUNT(*) AS sculpture_cnt
    FROM sculptures
    GROUP BY sculptorid
), artist_names AS (
    SELECT artistid,
           fname AS first_name,
           TRIM(COALESCE(lname_part1,'') || CASE WHEN lname_part2 IS NOT NULL AND lname_part2 <> '' THEN ' ' || lname_part2 ELSE '' END) AS last_name
    FROM artists
)
SELECT an.first_name, an.last_name
FROM artist_names an
JOIN painters p ON an.artistid = p.artistid
LEFT JOIN sculptors s ON an.artistid = s.artistid
WHERE COALESCE(s.sculpture_cnt, 0) = 0
ORDER BY an.first_name, an.last_name
